dedupe_keys.name: argentina federal register of health establishments refes

description: Ministerio de Salud, Argentina publishes the list of health establishments, with and without inpatient beds, of every dependency and of public or private funding, that operate in the national territory under current regulations and are registered in the Registro Federal de Establecimientos de Salud (REFES). Coverage: Argentina nationwide; published on the national portal on 2026-08-03 with several CSV, XLS, XLSX and JSON files served from the ministry open data site. Format and access: CSV, XLS, JSON, XLSX, downloadable without registration from the Argentine open data portal (datos.gob.ar); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the fields, the establishment count and whether coordinates are included are unconfirmed; a listing "asentados" means registered, so unregistered facilities are missing. Simulation uses: healthcare-facility exposure, hospital-capacity and access analyses for emergency and hazard scenarios. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
